paragraphs: An E. coli outbreak linked to frozen blueberries has ended [1][21]. The outbreak caused 17 cases and 6 hospitalizations across 2 states, with no deaths reported [1]. The berries were imported from Chile and sold at Walmart and Publix [21].

Star Meat Delivery Inc. is recalling more than 83 tons of raw pork, beef, and goat products that were produced without federal inspection and labeled with fake USDA inspection marks [2][12]. Berlin Seeds is recalling 950 pounds of alfalfa sprouting seed due to potential contamination with Shiga toxin-producing E. coli and Salmonella [3][11]. One illness has been reported in connection with this seed [11]. GF Blends is recalling Truly AIP All Purpose Flour and Bread Mix and EAT G.A.N.G.S.T.E.R. Flat Bread Pizza Mix because they may contain undeclared wheat gluten, which poses a risk to people with celiac disease or severe gluten intolerance [5].

A federal court order dated September 21, 2026, has banned Gold Star Distribution Inc. from distributing food and other FDA-regulated products until it fixes persistent insanitary warehouse conditions, including rodent infestation [4][9]. The FDA has identified two new outbreaks this week, though sources of the pathogens have not yet been identified [8].
